1934, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 272 Cont.
Nov. 21 Hector Parm - 65 - "nothing but gold & pleasure
Powell Kingsley - 36 - convert from Toledo - Arthritis 3 yrs. - quite helpless - made novena to St. Jude that they might be able come To-day ... last night turned over by himself - is here without pain and hopeful of walking before getting home to Toledo ...
Harry Slavatoski - 21 - wayward - away from home - badly hurt in Rec. Hosp. Enrolled at 5 P.M. last Sunday - Escaped what police were astonished at - 8P.M. - Escaped death.
J. T. Mclaughlin of Pasadena, Cal. - cancer not much changed but hopeful.
Charles Jomes - 9 - cripple - not Cath. - in harness - quite help- less - no hopes from Dr's or "healers"
Mary McCann - 14 - St. Mary's fearful disentery off and on since last May - down to 64 1bs.
Page 273 Page 274
Blank Page
Nov. 21 Lena Lafala - 25 - kidney stones ... had two operations, fears an- other.
Emma and Florence Rieker - deaf & dumm Sister nearing middle age ... since 2 yrs. - mastoids.
Mrs. Peters Mother ... losing toes.
Mrs. Nellie Revis - 44 - gall-infection operation expected - re- moval of gall-blader - Enrolled To-day - promises perpetual enroll- ment and frequent Communion if things go well.
Charles Sweeney - 17 - (seeNov.8) coming O.K.but so far totally deaf - 140000units "Syrum" which was 60000 over maximum
Albertina Litzen - 73 - Eczima - terrible hands - 8 yrs ... Miss - 22 - mind threatened - Extremely scrupulos.
Page 275 Blank Page
